title: Orsen and the Crown
author: W. M. Almeida
blurb: Sable Montrose, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
